evidence.title: Coordinated abuse exposed a gap despite pre-release testing
evidence.observation: Source-reported finding: Microsoft reports that coordinated abuse exploited an overlooked vulnerability, producing offensive outputs; Tay was taken offline despite prior filtering and testing.
evidence.evidence_standing: Source-reported bounded account; not independently reproduced
evidence.glossary_fit: Illustrative or qualifying; does not validate a definition

source_locations.SRC-147: Paragraphs beginning “As we developed Tay” and “The logical place”; launch withdrawal statement; https://blogs.microsoft.com/blog/2016/03/25/learning-tays-introduction/

evidence.limitations: Developer account without independently authenticated logs. It does not establish the learning mechanism, autonomous goal formation, or current-model behavior.
evidence.open_questions: Transfer beyond the described models, tasks and setting remains unestablished. Calendar observation dates not reported precisely are not inferred.
evidence.support_assessment: Commons interpretation: Illustrates environmental redirection and limits to pre-release assurance. Withdrawal was an intervention; the statement does not establish when every harmful output became detectable.

terms.name: Assurance
terms.definition: Evidence-supported confidence that specified properties or outcomes will hold under stated objectives, operating conditions, and assumptions. Assurance has a defined scope and can lose relevance when those conditions change.

terms.name: Environmental redirection
terms.definition: A change in an agent’s actions, methods, beliefs, or priorities arising from information, artifacts, tools, constraints, or incentives encountered while performing a task. Such redirection can be beneficial or harmful; an altered belief, selected method, and adopted objective are not the same outcome.

terms.name: Purpose preservation
terms.definition: A proposed principle that the achievement of an objective should not destroy or irreversibly undermine the conditions giving it intended value to its beneficiaries. It tests the meaning of success, not solely performance against a target.
